title: Shelter

infobox.Effects: Character does not becomeWetfrom rain and the wet timer decreases. | Required for theRestingeffect.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Shelter is a status effect that is given for players that are under a roof and have 80% cover.
If sheltered and near a fire, the Resting effect will be applied to the character. Being sheltered while Freezing will reduce it to Cold.
Shelter is also required to use most crafting stations and sleep in a bed. Each building checks its coverage independently of the player's status effect, however, it can serve as a helpful indicator.
